name: Armory
_source: speak;{unit};"Need to be quick and grab whathever looks useful."
Nelad;Hello?|...Empty...{w}{clear}...Hm? What's this?|Oh! This bow looks better than my own...|I hope no-one minds if I borrow it.
Anael;Empty, as expected. While I'm here, I might as well make use of this stuff. I'm sure the old man won't mind if I forget to pay. I'm doing it for a good cause, after all.

Bramar;HEY!! ...Nobody in here...|Hm? What's that?|Oooh, this is a nice axe! Right amount ta' heft to it too, just how I like it. It would be a shame t' just let ya collect dust, now would it? It's decided: you're coming with me!
